subject: *: unifiy the usage of max_execution_time (#64361)
summary: Centralizes SELECT-only semantics for `max_execution_time` in `SessionVars.GetMaxExecutionTime()` (guarded by `StmtCtx.InSelectStmt`) and updates executor/processinfo + point/batch-point-get + lock paths to consistently use this hint-aware accessor; NT-DML keeps saving/restoring the raw `MaxExecutionTime` session var to avoid losing the original value when `GetMaxExecutionTime()` is 0 in non-SELECT contexts.
